outcome: Study one Shakespeare play and one 19th-century novel in full.
Study one whole play from Macbeth, Romeo and Juliet, The Tempest, The Merchant of Venice, Much Ado About Nothing or Julius Caesar.
Study one whole novel such as Jekyll and Hyde, A Christmas Carol, Great Expectations, Jane Eyre, Frankenstein, Pride and Prejudice or The Sign of Four.
Study a modern text, a poetry cluster and unseen poetry.
Study one whole post-1914 drama or prose text from the set list, such as An Inspector Calls or Lord of the Flies.
Study all 15 poems in one cluster of Poems Past and Present: Love and Relationships, Power and Conflict, or Worlds and Lives.
Read widely and analyse and compare the content, theme, structure and language of unseen poems.
Develop reading and writing skills through the set texts.
Understand literally and by inference: plot, character, setting, motivation, and what is stated versus implied.
Identify themes, support a view with evidence and evaluate different responses to a text.
Use social, historical and cultural context to inform an evaluation and a personal response.
Evaluate how a writer's vocabulary, grammar, structure and form create impact, using literary terminology.
Compare texts by theme, character, context, style and quality.
Write clearly and coherently to describe, explain, argue, analyse and evaluate, with relevant quotation.
Use accurate spelling, punctuation and grammar in Standard English.
